caption: The drawing depicts a religious reliquary made of wood and decorated in multiple colors, mainly shades of red, green, and light brown. The reliquary stands on a rectangular, footed base with curved ornamentation and green scrollwork patterns. A central vertical pedestal, decorated with vertical stripes of red and green, rises from the base to support the upper, circular portion of the reliquary. This upper section is round, framed with red and green lines, and contains several inset medallion images. At the top center is a circular image of a person robed in blue and red, holding an infant. To the left is an image of a reclining figure in shades of white and gray, and to the right is a depiction of a crucifixion with a figure on the cross, using brown and gray tones. Beneath the main circular frame are two oval medallions arranged side by side, one encased in a small red box-like frame with a white interior. The frame is further adorned with four small red circular motifs and two vertical panels with white, netted cloth-like decorations at both sides. The overall drawing is done on a plain, beige background with delicate, fine lines and colored shading, with the artist's signature 'W.A. FIECKHOFER' written in the lower right.
title: Reliquary of Father Junipero Serra
